panels.description:
### Response time
Time the query-frontend took to answer the query, from request to response.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.99, {cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"query-frontend"} |~ `msg="(search response|query range response|query instant results)"` | logfmt | tenant=~"${tenant_id}" | query_type=~"${query_type}" | label_format query_duration=`{{ .duration_seconds }}s` | query_duration > ${min_duration} | unwrap duration_seconds | __error__="" [$__auto]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.5, {cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"query-frontend"} |~ `msg="(search response|query range response|query instant results)"` | logfmt | tenant=~"${tenant_id}" | query_type=~"${query_type}" | label_format query_duration=`{{ .duration_seconds }}s` | query_duration > ${min_duration} | unwrap duration_seconds | __error__="" [$__auto]) by ()

panels.title: Response time

panels.description:
### Inspected spans
Number of spans the queriers evaluated to answer the query. A search with no span conditions reports zero.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.99, {cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"query-frontend"} |~ `msg="(search response|query range response|query instant results)"` | logfmt | tenant=~"${tenant_id}" | query_type=~"${query_type}" | label_format query_duration=`{{ .duration_seconds }}s` | query_duration > ${min_duration} | unwrap inspected_spans | __error__="" [$__auto]) by ()

panels.title: Inspected spans

panels.description:
### Inspected bytes
Bytes the queriers read from blocks and live-stores to answer the query, including bytes served from the cache.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.99, {cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"query-frontend"} |~ `msg="(search response|query range response|query instant results)"` | logfmt | tenant=~"${tenant_id}" | query_type=~"${query_type}" | label_format query_duration=`{{ .duration_seconds }}s` | query_duration > ${min_duration} | unwrap inspected_bytes | __error__="" [$__auto]) by ()

panels.title: Inspected bytes

panels.description:
### Response size
Size of the response returned to the client.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.99, {cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"query-frontend"} |= "query stats" | logfmt | regexp `url="?\S*/api/(v2/)?(?P<query_type>search|metrics)` | query_type!="" | url!~".*/search/tag.*" | tenant=~"${tenant_id}" | query_type=~"${query_type}" | duration > ${min_duration} | response_size > 0 | unwrap response_size | __error__="" [$__auto]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.5, {cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"query-frontend"} |= "query stats" | logfmt | regexp `url="?\S*/api/(v2/)?(?P<query_type>search|metrics)` | query_type!="" | url!~".*/search/tag.*" | tenant=~"${tenant_id}" | query_type=~"${query_type}" | duration > ${min_duration} | response_size > 0 | unwrap response_size | __error__="" [$__auto]) by ()

panels.title: Response size

panels.description:
### Time span
Time range that the query covers, from its start time to its end time.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.99, {cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"query-frontend"} |~ `msg="(search response|query range response|query instant results)"` | logfmt | tenant=~"${tenant_id}" | query_type=~"${query_type}" | label_format query_duration=`{{ .duration_seconds }}s` | query_duration > ${min_duration} | label_format time_span_seconds=`{{ if .range_nanos }}{{ div .range_nanos 1000000000 }}{{ else }}{{ .range_seconds }}{{ end }}` | unwrap time_span_seconds | __error__="" [$__auto]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.5, {cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"query-frontend"} |~ `msg="(search response|query range response|query instant results)"` | logfmt | tenant=~"${tenant_id}" | query_type=~"${query_type}" | label_format query_duration=`{{ .duration_seconds }}s` | query_duration > ${min_duration} | label_format time_span_seconds=`{{ if .range_nanos }}{{ div .range_nanos 1000000000 }}{{ else }}{{ .range_seconds }}{{ end }}` | unwrap time_span_seconds | __error__="" [$__auto]) by ()

panels.title: Time span

panels.description:
### Jobs per query
Number of jobs the query-frontend split the query into. Each job runs on a querier, so more jobs means the query uses more of the read path.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.99, {cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"query-frontend"} |~ `msg="(search response|query range response|query instant results)"` | logfmt | tenant=~"${tenant_id}" | query_type=~"${query_type}" | label_format query_duration=`{{ .duration_seconds }}s` | query_duration > ${min_duration} | unwrap total_requests | __error__="" [$__auto]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.5, {cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container=~"query-frontend"} |~ `msg="(search response|query range response|query instant results)"` | logfmt | tenant=~"${tenant_id}" | query_type=~"${query_type}" | label_format query_duration=`{{ .duration_seconds }}s` | query_duration > ${min_duration} | unwrap total_requests | __error__="" [$__auto]) by ()
